name: Pane
text: Pane: A fixed-height strip buries the playback mark under fresh noise because users scroll past it to see new content, not because it’s always visible—constant visibility doesn’t solve the problem of competing visual priorities. Better: a thin, sticky timeline that only appears when the user hovers near the top, trading constant visibility for on-demand clarity. Settle it with a 10-user test: measure how often they locate the playback mark within 5 seconds of scrubbing.
